findings.title: Checker accepts governance violations while reporting all required checks as PASS
findings.observation: The supplied checker validates several mandatory gates with path or keyword presence only and exits before writing the required ERROR JSON for parameter/head errors.
findings.trigger: A plan retains expected field names and comments while containing an invalid acceptance row or contradictory authority, or another project-level state ledger is added outside the eight-plan directory.
findings.impact: The checker emits PASS and a valid-looking digest for content that violates the governance contract, allowing false verification evidence to authorize later review, merge or plan-state decisions.

evidence.description: Implementation-plan lines 247-264 and 289-330 require semantic acceptance/staleness/authority checks, alternate-ledger and private-artifact detection, and FAIL/ERROR JSON output.
The task-evidence checker limits FILES, ACCEPTANCE_HISTORY, REVIEW_AUTHORITY and STALENESS to file/token presence and writes JSON only after early error exits.
An isolated fixture with an invalid Review-authored Rejected acceptance row and a second project-status ledger still returned exit 0, overall PASS and 13/13 PASS.
A head-mismatch invocation returned exit 2 without writing the required ERROR JSON.

findings.remediation: Implement structured checks for additional ledgers, acceptance IDs/versions/pointers/result authority/value rules, paired staleness state, Review-rejection separation, declared secret/private/generated-file boundaries and contract-shaped failure/error output.
findings.verification: The exact head remains byte-stable PASS, while negative fixtures for invalid acceptance results, duplicate IDs, pointer/version mismatch, authority contradictions, staleness mismatch, alternate ledger, secret/private artifacts and parser/argument errors fail deterministically; then update the PR envelope and request re-review.

required_actions.action: Correct the external checker, prove the negative fixtures fail, rerun at the exact live head, update the VerificationEnvelope and request lifecycle re-review.
